findings.title: BondBaseTeller.createFeeDiscount is never initialized. It is used in
findings.description:
A state variable is read before anything ever writes it, so it holds the zero value. Slither: BondBaseTeller.createFeeDiscount (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#62) is never initialized. It is used in:
	- BondFixedExpiryTeller.create(ERC20,uint48,uint256) (src/BondFixedExpiryTeller.sol#96-132)

findings.title: BondFixedExpiryTeller.create(ERC20,uint48,uint256) ignores return value by underlying_.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount_)
findings.description: A token transfer's return value is ignored; a failed transfer passes silently. Slither: BondFixedExpiryTeller.create(ERC20,uint48,uint256) (src/BondFixedExpiryTeller.sol#96-132) ignores return value by underlying_.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount_) (src/BondFixedExpiryTeller.sol#111)

findings.title: Reentrancy in BondBaseTeller.claimFees(ERC20[],address)
findings.description:
The function calls out to another contract before it finishes updating its own state. A malicious callee can re-enter while the state is half-written; no ether moves in the reentrant path itself, but the stale state can be abused. Slither: Reentrancy in BondBaseTeller.claimFees(ERC20[],address) (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#99-108):
	External calls:
	- token.safeTransfer(to_,send) (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#106)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- rewards[msg.sender][token] = 0 (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#105)
	BondBaseTeller.rewards (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#67) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- BondBaseTeller.claimFees(ERC20[],address) (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#99-108)
	- BondBaseTeller.rewards (src/bases/BondBaseTeller.sol#67)

findings.title: BondFixedExpiryTeller._handlePayout(address,uint256,ERC20,uint48) uses timestamp for comparisons
findings.description:
Logic depends on block.timestamp, which miners can nudge by a few seconds (informational). Slither: BondFixedExpiryTeller._handlePayout(address,uint256,ERC20,uint48) (src/BondFixedExpiryTeller.sol#66-91) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- vesting_ > uint48(block.timestamp) (src/BondFixedExpiryTeller.sol#83)
